name: CTA Link

representativeVariants.name: Section exit — default
representativeVariants.whySelected: The homepage repeatedly uses bold uppercase exits such as 查看全部 and 更多日常 with a trailing arrow.

representativeVariants.name: Hero — filled
representativeVariants.whySelected: 开始阅读 is the primary route out of the homepage hero and uses the same 16/24px padding model as the main CTA.

representativeVariants.name: Hero — outline
representativeVariants.whySelected: 关于我 is the white inverse of the hero CTA and keeps the black 2px boundary visible.

representativeVariants.name: Footer — inverse
representativeVariants.whySelected: Footer navigation reverses the body palette and exposes quiet text links without extra surfaces.

usageHints.priorityHint: Use for route exits and content discovery; use the filled form only for the single main action in a section.
usageHints.a11y: The visible label must describe the destination; preserve a clear focus state and do not make the arrow the only cue.

doNotInvent: underlines on every static nav item
